new.doc: The extended offset (`SmOffsetExecutive::GetCreateExtendedSurface`) extends a ball patch (the blend corner's Ball, `fillet_blend_corner`) as itself, a ball patch on its sphere: its net carried on with `SM_CT_CINFINITY`, which stays on the sphere, around its pole by no more than a quarter of the turn its third side leaves open on each side and away from the pole by no more than half the arc left to the pole's antipode.

`ApproximateSurface` rejects a pass of cubic Bezier patches when any row (or column) of patches has a sample outside the tolerance, so the next subdivision runs, and fails (`SM_ERR`) when the last allowed one is still outside it: an approximation it returns is within the tolerance it was asked for.

`SmVertex::IsTopologicalVertex` ([`crate::topology::vertex::is_topological_vertex`]) counts a vertex as removable only when every one of its uses is an edge use of its two edges, the precondition of joining two edges at a vertex (Mäntylä's `KEV`).

A face's planar section with no approximation tolerance given (`SmBrep::CreatePlanarSectionCurves` and `SmSurface::CreatePlanarSectionCurves` through [`crate::topology::brep::planar_section::face_planar_section_curves`], `SmApiIntersectBrepWithPlane`) is traced to the face's tolerance, as the curves are to lie within it of the face, where upstream passes the null on and the surface intersector traces to its default, 1/1000 of the surface's size: a G^n round's section on a 40 x 30 x 20 box left the round by 5.2e-3 at a face tolerance of 1.6e-4 (WR-723, #2451; solidcore-native, no fork commit).

`SmFace::SwapUV` transposes each UV trim by swapping its control points' `u` and `v` ([`crate::nurbs::b_spline_curve::BSplineCurve::create_transposed_curve`]), where upstream mirrors it about the plane through the origin with x axis `(1, 1, 0)` unitised: the rounded unit vector makes `N_CrvTransform`'s matrix `I - 2nn^T` `-2.2e-16` on the diagonal and `1 + 2.2e-16` off it, so every coordinate of a swapped face's trims moves by up to an ulp and a trim's end on a domain bound lands past it (a unit box's three faces `StitchAndOrient` swaps end at `v = -2.2e-16` and `1 - 1.1e-16` on `[0, 1]`).

`N_SrfIsClosedSmooth` ([`crate::nurbs::srf_basic::Surface::is_closed_smooth_with_fixes`]) takes the G1 test across the seam at a station where the derivative across the seam vanishes (a collapsed row, a pole on the seam: shorter than `0.001 * NL_MTOL`, the pole test of `N_SrfEvalPtNormalAtPole`) by its limit, the mixed derivative `S_uv` (`S_uv` for the v seam), negated at the end of the domain, where upstream takes the angle of the two vanishing vectors: their rounding then decides between `NL_GEO_ERR` (two exact zeros), not smooth (two noise vectors at any angle) and smooth, so a sphere is not reported closed and smooth in u (WR-725, #2521; solidcore-native, no fork commit).

With `fillet_cliff_overflow` (and `fillet_refuse_rails_leaving_faces` and `fillet_exact_round_classes`, which it builds on), a lone constant round bigger than the wall it rolls on ends on the body's outline instead of being built on the wall continued past its rim and cut from the body.

With `fillet_blend_corner`, a vertex of three constant circular rounds of one convexity where a face is a natural quadric (a cylinder, cone or sphere; the others planes) is the blend corner's Setback too ([`crate::blend::blend_corner::setback`]; the fork's 37c9e1d, smlib#85 part C, built in solidcore).
